decisions.summary: The registry census takes every URL in a registry entry, its HTML comments included
decisions.why: Round 1's NOT LEGITIMATE item, cleared: FR-001 says every URL in a registry entry; the plan now counts the comment URLs (the page actually read, and the one entry whose only URL is in a comment), and archive.py `cited`/`entry_line` call urls_in(comments=True) for entries.

decisions.summary: A footnote's cited URL is one a notes.html footnote links; URLs in notes comments are not taken
decisions.why: FR-001 says every URL a footnote LINKS; a session-note comment is not a link, and those URLs are search trails and pages read and not cited (round 1 ruling stands).

decisions.summary: Whole page as a Chromium MHTML snapshot
decisions.why: FR-002: images, stylesheets and fonts in one self-contained file that opens offline in a browser.

decisions.summary: Live fetch first, then by failure class: DEAD -> Wayback, GM copy, unreachable with page-cache text; REFUSED/no text -> GM copy, Wayback, partial with page-cache text; every matched GM file copied regardless; a source page lists every copy of every URL it cites
decisions.why: Round 1's NOT LEGITIMATE item, cleared. The refused branch is the spec's Edge Cases order (GM copy, then snapshot, then partial with the cache text). The dead branch is US1 scenario 3 (snapshot, else unreachable with the cache text stored), with the GM copy between them, which FR-012 itself provides: the GM-copy outcome is used where the live fetch 'fails or is refused'. Listing every copy of every URL is FR-010. scripts/_archive.py `capture` implements both orders as written.
The spec's manifest, one row per cited URL.

decisions.summary: Capture time is the version directory
decisions.why: FR-009 and the re-archiving edge case.

decisions.summary: Reserve never blocks; failed push writes pending-upload, 7-day grace
decisions.why: FR-006 and the grace-period edge case.

decisions.summary: Politeness: one request per host, 1 s apart, one retry on 429/503
REFUSED = 401/403/406/429/451 or a web page that rendered no text; DEAD = any other 4xx/5xx, network error, empty body, redirect to the site root from a deeper path
decisions.why: Splits the spec's two classes: DEAD carries US1 scenario 3's three cases (error status, dead host, front-page redirect); REFUSED carries the Edge Cases' 'refuses an automated reader' and 'needs a script to show its text'. Every failure lands in one of the two spec-named orders, so nothing is dropped.

decisions.summary: <key>/<id>/<time>/ layout, gm-copy/, notes/<id>/, shared URL archived once, >95 MB split with checksum
academic-sources matched file by file; unmatched listed; the 2 GM lists skipped
decisions.why: FR-012 covers copies of cited sources and asks the unmatched to be listed (round 1 spot check stands).

decisions.summary: Engine/tooling split, Makefile targets, reserve URL hook, working copy and lock, PAT via env, 4 workers
decisions.why: FR-006, FR-007, FR-008, FR-011 as written.
